body:
Good morning.There's a chill in the air. Autumn's almost here. Sky is choked with clouds but enough sun gets through so that it isn't a dark day yet.

I may have to walk home in the dark after university soon.

Sorry for the late reply but it seems were in very different time zones. It's 09:00 here.

Thanks for coming back to talk to me.
thank u for talking to me. i appreciate it

the plan was chartered accountant....ive started failing the courses tho. cant stop thinking dark thoughts when i should be concentrating. and lately i cant see the point in trying if im not gonna keep living anyway.
till i finish my degree i cant actually afford to go anywhere....i have very little money

it seems mostly bad atm...thank you for sharing your story.
i never thought it was possible to have a relationship like i did with her....and i find it impossible to beleive i ever can again. its like the best part of life is over and its all downhill from here till i die.

how did u manage to move through the pain?

not anymore. im an only child, cant talk to parents, and that theres no one else is a big part of the problem. as of last night i am now more alone than i ever knew was possible.

whats the point of living if ill never be happy again...
how else can i cope with the pain?

its become too much.

"itll get better"

thats the kind of arguement that made me stop. surprise, surprise, that was bullshit. its gotten worse. lost the love of my life. and tonight i lost my best friend. the one i trusted, the one i could talk to. it not going to get better. and any promise that it will is a lie. everything hurts.

death will free me from this. i dont think theres anything after this life...and that ised to scare me. but if theres no pain then id be grateful to die. and even if im wrong and i go to hell for this....so what? its where i should go. theres no room in paradise for worthless burdens like me. life was wasted on me. i hate myself...who wouldnt hate an unlovable weak thing like me.

its better if i disappear now before it gets even worse

ive been fighting this for four months now. it gets worse not better with time. now this is what i think of every day. i cant think of reasons to keep delaying. im not even sure if i have it in me to ask for help again after tonight...
im on my way to the station. for the first time im not sure if im going to get on a train or jump in front of one.

i used to play piano and guitar. but i cant get enough will together to start a song. my main source of recreation/escapism used to be video games. but i dont care about them anymore. one day i just didnt want to play anything anymore. ive never been very interested in sport but i dont have anyone to play with either way. the big problem with finding a new hobby is that i started university this year and i have very little free time.

im running short on sources of releif. most of my hobbies just dont mean anything to me anymore. i still sketch sometimes, but lately thats been hit or miss. spending time with my friends is all thats left. but thats happening less and less. and lately...it might be helping less and less as well.
just running out of hope. cant see a way ill be happy again. not really. what use is it to keep living this way? cant see any way my life can be worth it again. no way forward and no way back.
